name: @vlln/dsh-autofork
description: DSH 插件：agent 忙时自动分叉会话 —— 你新发的指令立刻在新会话里得到响应，旧会话留在后台跑完并把结果回注。官方 bundle 插件，装：dsh plugin --profile web add github:vlln/dsh-autofork

scripts.check: node --check index.mjs && node --check src/digest.mjs && node --check src/params.mjs && node --check src/tools.mjs && node --check src/lineage.mjs && node --check client/index.js
scripts.check:e2e: node --check tests/e2e/drive.mjs && node --check tests/e2e/mock-server.mjs && node --check tests/e2e/verify-lineage.mjs && node --check tests/e2e/session-dir.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run check:e2e && npm run check:dev && npm run gate && npm test
